label: Logical space gives only logical necessity (inference)
rule: Witness selection from saturation and structural induction
meaning: If every truth-value assignment to the atoms is realized at a world accessible from w, then a box-free formula boxed at w holds at the world realizing any given assignment, hence truth-functionally under that assignment: it is a tautology. The converse (tautologies are boxed) holds on every frame (controls). Derives the formal 'only logical necessity' thesis from combinatorial logical space, for the box of the selected frame and valuation; it says nothing about formulas with box or about existence unless a valuation expresses it.
